---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

**Problem this solves**
What pain point or gap does this address? One sentence, user-facing.

**Proposed solution**
Describe what you want to happen or what capability you need.

**Alternatives considered**
Other tools or workarounds you've tried — helps us understand the constraint.

**Affected component(s)**
- [ ] Container / Dockerfile
- [ ] MCP gateway
- [ ] Ghidra bridge (`bridge_mcp_ghidra.py`)
- [ ] Shell server (`shell-mcp.py`)
- [ ] r2mcp / radare2 tools
- [ ] angr MCP
- [ ] Agents (`.claude/agents/`)
- [ ] CI / build
- [ ] Docs

**Additional context**
Relevant links, upstream issues, or prior discussion.
